actions: Traced Recuris production candidate SHA binding through dev gate and commit path.
Audited Recuris commit journals, immutable version promotion and restart reconciliation.
Mapped Recuris released tau2 train/dev/test split semantics and driver use of test_ids.
Confirmed Recuris run-level campaign artifacts are intentionally excluded from the public Git release.
Audited StarHarness full paper and released hill-climbing loop for search/selection/holdout isolation, repeated selection reuse and exact promotion predicate.
Confirmed StarHarness local proposal/run chronology paths are gitignored in the public release.
Ran fresh exact-title/arXiv/GitHub searches for official PACE and SEA implementations; no suitable official implementation was established.
material_findings: Recuris production promotion binds evaluated candidate package bytes by SHA-256 and rechecks the digest immediately before commit.

Recuris uses recoverable write-ahead commit/finalization journals: before immutable version rename it can roll back; after rename restart reconciliation roll-forwards state/finalization after digest verification.

Recuris evolution driver does not evaluate released test_ids; released tau2 evolution files have test=[] and reserve the remaining tasks outside the driver, which is protocol isolation but not a physically inaccessible lockbox.

StarHarness evaluates its outer holdout once after the hill-climbing evolution loop, but repeatedly reuses one hidden selection set with a raw strict-improvement/tie-verifier promotion rule and no repeated-selection correction in the released path.
StarHarness reports 21 accepted patches across three runs, while total proposal count and complete paper-run chronology remain unavailable from the public Git release.
Both Recuris and StarHarness can generate rich local chronologies, but their run directories are intentionally gitignored, limiting independent fixed-proposal acceptor replay.

termination.cause: physical invocation boundary after material checkpoint and durable continuation update

exact_next_action: Inspect Recuris exception/provisional-progressive promotion semantics; search for released Recuris paper-run ma_runs or >10-proposal chronology; audit StarHarness tree search and proposal budgets/selection feedback exposure; continue exact official PACE/SEA implementation search for durable certificate state; continue searching for a >10-proposal live agent combining candidate-local anytime-valid evidence, durable cross-candidate statistical spending, complete public proposal chronology and a genuinely untouched outer test; continue randomized/crossover artifact-retirement evidence searches.
